tasks.title: Urbanization in the Nineteenth Century
paras: The nineteenth century witnessed a dramatic shift in population dynamics because of urbanization. Industrialization played a crucial role in this transformation, drawing people from rural areas to cities in search of employment and better living conditions. The proliferation of factories and the promise of higher wages attracted a diverse workforce, including women and children.

Cities expanded rapidly, leading to overcrowded living conditions and inadequate infrastructure. Housing was often substandard, and sanitation issues were prevalent. As a result, urban areas became hot spots for diseases such as cholera and tuberculosis. Despite the challenges faced by urban planners and legislators, urbanization brought significant advancements in public transportation, communication, and commerce.

The influx of people into cities also led to major cultural shifts and the rise of new social classes. A burgeoning middle class emerged, distinguished by its economic power and influence. This class played a pivotal role in advocating for social reforms, including improved working conditions and public - health measures. While urbanization presented numerous obstacles, it undeniably laid the groundwork for modern society.

questions.stem: The word “proliferation” in the passage is closest in meaning to
questions.analysis: 正确答案：C 题型：词汇题 原文定位：The proliferation of factories and the promise of higher wages attracted a diverse workforce 解析：proliferation 意为激增、大量涌现，文中指工厂数量大幅增加。 选项分析： A. replacement（取代）—— 语义不符 B. reduction（减少）—— 含义相反 C. increase（增长、增多）—— 同义替换，正确 D. movement（移动）—— 无关

questions.stem: What was a significant effect of industrialization in the nineteenth century?

options.C: Reduced employment opportunities for women in cities
options.D: The development of improved agricultural practices for rural areas

questions.analysis: 正确答案：A 题型：细节理解题 原文定位：Industrialization…drawing people from rural areas to cities 解析：工业化吸引大量农村人口迁入城市，直接导致农村人口减少。 选项分析： A. Decreasing populations in rural areas—— 农村人口下降，符合原文，正确 B. Improved sanitation in cities—— 当时卫生条件恶劣，错误 C. Reduced employment for women—— 文中女性涌入城市务工，错误 D. Improved agricultural practices—— 全文未提及农业改良，无中生有

questions.stem: Why does the author mention diseases such as cholera and tuberculosis?

options.A: To illustrate the health challenges faced by urban areas
options.B: To emphasize the need for modern health care
options.C: To compare urban and rural health conditions
options.D: To suggest that these diseases were almost eradicated in the nineteenth century

questions.analysis: 正确答案：A 题型：修辞目的题 原文定位：sanitation issues were prevalent…urban areas became hot spots for diseases 解析：举例各类疾病，用来体现城市化带来的恶劣卫生与健康危机。 选项分析： A. 说明城市面临的健康难题 —— 贴合举例目的，正确 B. 强调现代医疗需求 —— 文中无现代医疗相关内容 C. 对比城乡健康差异 —— 只讲城市，无对比 D. 表明疾病基本被消灭 —— 与当时疫病泛滥事实相反

questions.stem: How did urbanization impact public transportation?

options.A: It led to a decline in the quality of public transportation.
options.B: It brought various improvements to public transportation.
options.C: It caused a reduction in public transportation options.
options.D: It made public transportation more expensive for city residents.

questions.analysis: 正确答案：B 题型：细节理解题 原文定位：urbanization brought significant advancements in public transportation 解析：城市化推动、完善了公共交通发展。 选项分析： A. 降低交通质量 —— 与 advancements 相反 B. 为公共交通带来多项进步 —— 完全对应原文，正确 C. 减少交通选择 —— 文意相反 D. 使交通费用更贵 —— 文中未提及价格

questions.stem: What is the relationship between paragraphs 2 and 3?

options.A: Paragraph 3 contradicts the points made in paragraph 2.
options.B: Paragraph 3 offers solutions to the problems mentioned in paragraph 2.
options.C: Paragraph 3 provides evidence to support the claims made in paragraph 2.
options.D: Paragraph 3 discusses the social changes that resulted from the conditions described in paragraph 2.

questions.analysis: 正确答案：D 题型：段落关系题原文定位：第 2 段：城市拥挤、卫生差、疾病等现实问题第 3 段：人口涌入引发阶级变化、文化变革、社会改革 解析：第三段承接第二段的城市环境与人口现状，讲述由此引发的社会层面变化。 选项分析： A. 相互反驳 —— 两段并列正负内容，无矛盾 B. 提出解决办法 —— 第三段无解决方案 C. 列举证据支撑 —— 并非佐证关系 D. 讨论第二段现状所引发的社会变革 —— 逻辑匹配，正确
